category_title: Student with Down Syndrome exhibiting constant disruptive verbalizations
scenario_title: Morning reading instruction in the general education classroom
minimal_context: The student is working individually on a modified reading worksheet during morning reading instruction in the general education classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for morning reading. Here is your modified reading worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes a loud vocalization while looking at the ability-level materials.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's try to read the first word on the page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues making loud noises instead of looking at the reading passage.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to focus on your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Produces constant noises and verbalizations loud enough to attract the attention of the other students working at the reading table across the room.)
